name: cocostudio
description: Monorepo with Next.js web app and NestJS clean architecture backend

scripts.db:generate: cd packages/database && dotenv -e ../../.env -- pnpm exec prisma generate
scripts.db:push: cd packages/database && dotenv -e ../../.env -- pnpm exec prisma db push
scripts.db:migrate: cd packages/database && dotenv -e ../../.env -- pnpm exec prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:deploy: cd packages/database && dotenv -e ../../.env -- pnpm exec prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:seed: cd packages/database && dotenv -e ../../.env -- pnpm exec prisma db seed
scripts.db:studio: cd packages/database && dotenv -e ../../.env -- pnpm exec prisma studio
scripts.db:reset: cd packages/database && dotenv -e ../../.env -- pnpm exec prisma migrate reset --force
